content.value: Make sentences on the following structures using the verbs given in brackets.
i) Subject + Intransitive verb + adverbial. (go as verb)
ii) Subject + Linking verb + adj. complement + extension. (seem as verb)
iii) Subject + Linking verb + noun complement + extension.
iv) Subject + Transitive verb + Infinitive as object.
v) Subject + Transitive verb + object + noun complement. (name as verb)
vi) Subject + Transitive verb + object + adj. complement. (hold as verb)
